Confirm that these two addresses reach the same Hub. The app checks authenticated reads, but the protocol cannot prove server identity. Matching credentials or usage are not proof. LAN HTTP sends credentials and data in cleartext; reused IPs or incorrect configuration remain risks. Confirmation allows automatic switching. You can disable LAN HTTP at any time.
